title: Ark of the Covenant as a device that strikes people dead with fire

tellings.quote: according to the the Book of Exodus. But also, it strikes people dead with bolts of fire that come out of it.

plain: The Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest the Bible says was made in the time of Moses, could kill people with fire, according to the writer Graham Hancock. Summarising the Book of Exodus and the Bible without pointing to a passage, Hancock says that it "strikes people dead with bolts of fire that come out of it." He raises it to suggest the Ark worked more like a powerful device than a simple box.
